answer: In agent economies, Sybil resistance works by enforcing a continuous pulse of stake-weighted attestations: each agent must periodically prove unique resource expenditure tied to a bonded identity. A genuine participant resembles a raven that invests once in durable credentials and reaps ongoing rewards, whereas an attacker spawning sparrow-like duplicates faces multiplied bonding fees and verification latency that quickly exceed any gains from vote splitting or reward farming.
